paragraphs: Rabbi Chiyya, his son. Pesikta Rabbati, HaChodesh, סכ״נ.

notes.text: The final locator סכ״נ is unclear in the frozen text.

The connected paragraph of the saved named OYW Pesikta Rabbati 15 (HaChodesh) explicitly reads רבי חייא בריה דרבי אחא דיפו on Exodus 12:21. This supports the contextual father supplied from the heading and provides a digital location alongside the supplied סכ״נ. That final locator remains unresolved; no section 50 or edition pagination is inferred.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 132) reads סכ״ג, whereas the supplied Hebrew reads סכ״נ. The consulted Pesikta Rabbati 15, HaChodesh, names Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Acha of Jaffa on Exodus 12:21, identifying whose son is meant. The exact numbering used by Hyman’s Pesikta edition remains unverified.
